design.bridge: For worker TASK/execute and QUESTION/analysis only, parse one exact WB_WORKER_RESPONSE: flat allowlisted JSON object from public OMP message_end; require canonical UUIDs, positive safe revision/generation, exact delivery/stage/kind/decision, stopReason stop, and no extra content. Store a candidate without publishing it. At terminal agent_end with matching session/provider evidence and no rejection, publish allowlisted assistant_message_end then delivery_omp_processed linked by workerResponseId. Other delivery_omp_processed semantics remain unchanged.
design.port: Production G3WorkerResponsePort consumes only G3BridgeServer public events with one-shot arm/observe, a shared deadline, exact receipt/message/session correlation, strict field/type checks, event ordering, linked response ID and duplicate-ID rejection.
design.probes: Both actual OMP probes now use G3WorkerResponsePort. The scripted provider emits a response in the public OMP content stream only; no provider private response dictionary or expected-marker environment dependency remains in either workflow probe.

runtime_evidence.privacy: Both probes report secret sentinel absent from durable files
runtime_evidence.cleanup: Both probes report zero OMP child/cwd process and provider-thread residue; bridge socket removed. Final ps pattern check found no owned runtime process.

scope_attribution.outside_scope_classification: Only graphify-out generated AST/cache/backup/graph files from required graphify update; no other outside-scope path changed relative to checkpoint.

remaining_unknowns: The provider remains a scripted local model fixture inside real OMP 18.2.10; behavior of arbitrary external models is not established by this runtime probe.
